skills.name: shell_command
skills.summary: Execute a shell command and return stdout/stderr/exit code

skills.name: file_operations
skills.summary: Read, write, list, delete, or move files and directories

skills.name: http_request
skills.summary: Make an HTTP request and return the response status, headers, and body

skills.name: pdf_parser
skills.summary: Download and extract text from a PDF file (by URL or local path)

skills.name: image_ocr
skills.summary: Extract text from an image (JPEG, PNG, GIF, BMP, TIFF, WebP) using the ocr.space OCR API. Does NOT require tesseract or any system binary. Supply image_url. Optional: api_key (defaults to free demo key), language (default: eng), ocr_engine (1=standard, 2=enhanced).

skills.name: web_search
skills.summary: Performs a web search using a query string and returns the top search result.

skills.name: websearch
skills.summary: Alias of web_search: performs a web search and returns the top result.

skills.name: send_email
skills.summary: Send an email via SMTP with optional HTML body and CC/BCC

skills.name: browse_web
skills.summary: Fetch a web page, extract text and links, optionally follow links

skills.name: text_summarize
skills.summary: Summarize text using extractive summarization with TF scoring

skills.name: ask_user
skills.summary: Ask the user a clarifying question and return the response

skills.name: mcp_list_tools
skills.summary: List available tools from a configured MCP server

skills.name: mcp_call_tool
skills.summary: Call a tool on a configured MCP server and return the result

skills.name: get_system_info
skills.summary: Return runtime facts about this OwnClaw deployment: executor URL, model, platform, shell. Use this as a first step whenever a task requires knowledge of configured services or environment.
